question: Who found out the relationship between the current I flowing in a metallic wire and the potential difference across its terminals?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Georg Simon Ohm__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Georg Simon Ohm was a **German physicist and mathematician.**
 
• **Georg Simon Ohm discovered Ohm's law.**
 
• Ohm's Law is vitally important in describing **electric circuit****s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **German-born Albert Einstein** was a theoretical physicist. The creation of Albert Einstein's** theory of relativity** has earned him widespread fame.
 
• The father of** nuclear physics, Ernest Rutherford,** was a New Zealander by nationality. With his well-known** gold foil experiment**, in which he proved that the atom had a small and heavy nucleus, **Rutherford improved Thomson's model in 1911.**
 
• **Rutherford **said that the electrons around the nucleus are in circular orbits called orbits. In these orbits, the electrons move very fast. Therefore, this atomic model is similar to the solar system, in which the sun is the nucleus and the planets are like moving electrons.
 
• **Dane Niels Bohr **was a physicist. In the atom model that Niels Bohr postulated, the electron could only occupy specific** orbits around the nucleus. **
